row.notes: Refreshes the whole driver info/contract card VM for driver id at +0xd78 (0x3fff = none) in career world +0xd70. Caches components at +0xda0..+0xdd8 (CareerBank, DriverMarket +0xdb8, DriverStatistics +0xdc0, PlayerDriverStatistics +0xdc8, DriverContractsMyTeam +0xdd8) and MyTeam flag +0xdec. Writes driver/team UIDB refs, team name strings, is-player bool, overall rating (Career_Get_DriverOverallRating -> float at +0x290, text via Ui_Format_RenownText, fraction node), market status icon (switch on market entry +0xce, case 4 uses "#overrides.team_hq.add_on_driver_icons.dlc_%s"). Option bytes +0xd82..+0xd91 gate sections: +0xd82 contract block (nodes salary, salary_with_dollarsign, salary_raw, is_reserve_driver, buyout_costs_valid, buyout_cost, contract_cost, perk_fund, previous_contract_cost(_valid), contract_cancellation_cost, recruitment_bonus, percent_of_salary; values from Career_DriverContracts_BuildDriverContractQuote and Ui_Format_ResourcePointsAmountText), +0xd84 per-stat rows with rating delta vs compare driver +0xd98 or season-on-season stats (FUN_14113dda0/FUN_14113ec50), +0xd88 perk boost row, +0xd8b leverage, +0xd8d "signing_information" counter-offer block, +0xd91 offer expiry date string. Central hook for anything shown on driver cards (salary, rating, stats).
